## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Featured Members
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099554

## Streaming Featured Members
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Featured Members section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the members selected to display as Featured Members of the website, to learn more about the process of setting up Featured Members, navigate to the following link: Featured Members on Homepage
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142163504/original/EVz0QeQr6RtCpp4jp_kGyQitagz03cPYQw.png?1713882505 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142163594/original/QZudLcfD1_IgCmiCujSgUMvKZnz-fp7oUg.png?1713882553 | alt: ]

## Visual Guide of the Streaming Featured Members Settings
This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Featured Members.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142171542/original/nV5fRDd5DeI6f1YKhRF10utBJXNnhMhTSw.png?1713888725 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164700647/original/lQDktGlhYsIuSP3nT18_EUyplTj0PtBBTg.png?1753206877 | alt: ]

## 1. Featured Members Title
This setting controls the title for this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142166337/original/sv8HLeIkqNgxiGs6Cj-mZ04xXyleDFz1Bw.png?1713884418 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142166357/original/xVzc5hFxa-DTbsVb7asFqjRT268LMXx22A.png?1713884429 | alt: ]

## 2. Title Color
This setting controls the title color for the title of this homepage section. It can be edited to match the website's needs.  Click on the color bar to display the color pallet and select the color accordingly.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142166410/original/whWXPLqSoG_bVRtPwc0mPfKm_YNdw93b0g.png?1713884467 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142166544/original/RiQDAcVaLu3-F3bgU73VPO6HMcBUC3x6_g.png?1713884543 | alt: ]

## 3. Display Options
This setting control the total amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167215/original/lQXYPzYN02HHO4q1x4j3fZ2wFxJHwzM8Zg.png?1713884983 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167279/original/Hhe8T9NvQpWSpOGySjJQGlKSz2KNyElJiw.png?1713885040 | alt: ]

## 4. Results Per Row
This setting control the amount of members that will be displayed on this homepage section per row. Click on the drop-down menu to select the number of total results from the list. The maximum is 24 results.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167346/original/jLid3booL3guNtLCNjd_ZfCeuY-KwhWwpQ.png?1713885105 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167356/original/1ujKYhPeVYscEpPuIDS_QyAH9Mzt8WnocQ.png?1713885114 | alt: ]

## 5. Enable Carousel Slider?
This setting control the layout of the Streaming Members section, if enabled the Streaming section will display as a carousel, with arrows at each side, instead of displaying the Streaming Members in a grid layout, they will appear in the carousel. If set to No, the Streaming Members will be displayed in the default grid view.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167455/original/bN2M6ZWaYp7xxFFinQt4yVuDBhs60vysSA.png?1713885178 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167645/original/TtHG7oEAfpjdfBOI2umhQePRx4f1JZxKhg.png?1713885340 | alt: ]

## 6. Hide On Mobile?
This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Members section will display on mobile devices. If enabled this section will not appear on mobile devices. If the setting is set to No, the Streaming Members section will appear on mobile devices accessing the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167674/original/hyax7ciT7udH55CUtwN-qO9_b2yKbztYxQ.png?1713885397 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167832/original/Cmr6bssKX4kOUPc9vWOnRh21p3bGA3JTng.png?1713885530 | alt: ]

## 7. Only Show Members with Photo
This setting controls whether or not the Streaming Featured Members section will display members that have already uploaded either a Member Image or Member Logo, but the system will only display the Member Image, not the Member Logo. The options are: "Show All, Even if Member Does Not Have Photo" or "Member Must Have Photo"
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142167970/original/EzkzXKcupEHNsMFGNFWmsi9cFM05Nzce6w.png?1713885699 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142168807/original/yHQTqYwF-YRdHW2Vh8qUz1MBWOshxIDocA.png?1713886378 | alt: ]

## 8. Display Additional Information
This setting controls the information displayed per member in the Streaming Members section on the homepage of the website. The options to choose from are:
Display About Snippet
Display Top Level Category
Display Sub Level Category
Display Short Description
Do Not Display Additional Information
Display About Snippet
Using this option will display the About Snippet field from the Contact Details form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169118/original/kQ36lfQdOkOjVuJ-N8mcpQARTxFMphXfyg.png?1713886609 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169169/original/1VTilsdIo4j-GbNilfbI023Rt34mAjs_nQ.png?1713886656 | alt: ]
Display Top Level Category
Using this option will display the Top Level Category from the Contact Details form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169369/original/yJ-XgkUDE-8icTVoZhug2kNS6nquVY9YwQ.png?1713886861 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169464/original/GYPJ6EdT3fIlqqtW6SUMFBmrRezPxKqNYA.png?1713886916 | alt: ]
Display Sub Level Category
Using this option will display the Sub Level Category from the Additional Details form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169491/original/sGQ9_ZPafNFQGTE41e3yBlev_kSYUwRmng.png?1713886961 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169548/original/_xzFaGFYg3dwa122-TDjECXfi85vA-YjTw.png?1713887014 | alt: ]
Display Sub Sub Level Category
Using this option will display the Sub Sub Level Category from the Additional Details form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169491/original/sGQ9_ZPafNFQGTE41e3yBlev_kSYUwRmng.png?1713886961 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169548/original/_xzFaGFYg3dwa122-TDjECXfi85vA-YjTw.png?1713887014 | alt: ]
Display Short Description
Using this option will display the Short Description from the Contact Details form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169730/original/WPVP-LXL5ZasWHERazWjY4OCYaamyP0RLg.png?1713887150 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142169944/original/8dmuWv70z01RC3fKv1ARm6GbVuB_IB7esQ.png?1713887352 | alt: ]
Do Not Display Additional Information
Using this option will hide this section.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142170054/original/pv9MoDRe1GuvgebPj6tKGDGKmQJqQ4kaYA.png?1713887402 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142170739/original/MrDx4LUy-N6qpmrP4bD4LCPOtKqXCtFRog.png?1713888022 | alt: ]

## 9. Display Location
This setting controls whether or not the address or location for the members is displayed on this section of the homepage. If set to Yes the location or address will be displayed, if set to No, the address or location will be hidden for the members on the Streaming Members section of the homepage.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142170830/original/4BzVO0UvUtzHvaSya2z5-Um74deW9AmAKw.png?1713888081 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142171141/original/74P42ZgniDCUk7XBRZ-bGQBB9DLu3ofIKw.png?1713888358 | alt: ]

## 10. Display Star Ratings
This setting enables or disables the display of star ratings for featured members. Administrators can choose to show or hide star ratings.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144017183/original/yQWxEyWnCSsByLIISBqS_Q3CTFa-G1bySg.png?1717015068 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144017222/original/wPIBgUNL1m9qD4gmvHvd2BuZ8U5iBwmFeg.png?1717015112 | alt: ]

## 11. Only Display Members Who Have Star Ratings
This setting specifies whether only members with star ratings should be displayed. It includes options to require a minimum star rating from 1 to 5 stars.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144017305/original/jA7i7cS1GdyBZtytdLJoX2DuDviLFo6rzw.png?1717015173 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144017232/original/RYXKKq95iTMuMpXuRORpfphwZ9q3LmRx7Q.png?1717015129 | alt: ]

## 12. Display View Profile Button
This setting controls whether or not the button that links website visitors to the member's profile will be displayed. If set to Yes, the button will appear in the Streaming Members widget of the homepage. If set to No, the button will not be displayed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142171243/original/E7H6z0dFUFcWX66Os9krz42QSKZWlGWJaQ.png?1713888452 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142171428/original/wt2-V401wXL2iKI0kGVHv8F5Y4lm7-03yA.png?1713888593 | alt: ]

## 13. Display Order
This setting controls the order in which the Featured Members will appear organized on the front end of the website. The options are Ascending lowest to highest, Descending highest to lowest and Random.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142171727/original/qrnC3VC8a0k5xIsoLlI2zaQnEBLi6kvGyg.png?1713888905 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12142171428/original/wt2-V401wXL2iKI0kGVHv8F5Y4lm7-03yA.png?1713888593 | alt: ]

## 14. Only Display 'Verified' Members?
This setting specifies whether only members that are " Verified " should be displayed.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164700829/original/CWBVFBCBXf3y2D_JTd-FfpCJMN5O8NfXMg.png?1753207085 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164705545/original/5dE7vP_TBqibZHFSoncRza6nJuLUxrleWA.png?1753212216 | alt: ]

## 15. Display Verified Badge?
This setting specifies whether the Verify Badge should be displayed or not.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164700933/original/4nk5QH8SWRtp-adFET3WHJvSpFnqK8Vslg.png?1753207188 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164705480/original/R7lWw3-86aUBqehjxgcDCijdJgGIOnuZAg.png?1753212158 | alt: ]
